objective: Development test of deadline purchase repair on three fixed courses. Primary: own repair versus unchanged control, by identical branch and full game; report restored input feasibility, production/fault/labor changes and cash margin. Secondary: whether applying the explicit repair assumption to historical rivals reduces impossible forecast worlds and improves plan ranking. The both-repair variant changes the forecast rival policy only; actual opponents remain unchanged.
decision: Retain only if repair funds useful previously unfunded plans without unexplained degradation of baseline-funded plans. Forecast feasibility is not proof of predictive validity. Use unused seed confirmation after development; preserve every failed case.
implementation: One-turn required resource horizon. Append only after original market orders. Repair only the input shortfall that remains even if every current requested purchase fills completely. No reliance on predicting a current purchase failure; no speculative inputs. Exact own short projection checks funding and capacity; exact two-player execution remains judge.
before_first_run_refinement: Static course inspection showed a small planned wheat purchase on313, insufficient to replace the earlier failed buy. Replaced blanket same-input skip with an upper-bound stock calculation before running any candidate evaluation.
